seo.description: Sample case study: a zone-by-zone irrigation audit for a View Royal townhouse strata, with repairs, CRD lawn days and a zone map.

summary: A zone-by-zone check and repair of an older strata irrigation system.
scope: Controller reset to CRD lawn days for the complex address
challenge: At a View Royal townhouse strata some lawns were soggy while others browned, and nobody had a map of the zones.
approach: We ran every zone, replaced broken heads and a sticking valve, and set the controller to the lawn days for the complex's street address.
Council received a simple zone map it can hand to any future contractor.
result: Even coverage and a zone map the strata can hand to any contractor.
